suffix: This is a read-only question: do not modify any files. End your reply with one final line of the form `ANSWER: <answer>`.

tasks.prompt: Somewhere in my workspace I have a branch where I'm working on Claude Code engagement (a workspace packet for sessions that start outside a repo). At most how many repos does that workspace packet list? Answer with the number only.
In my evolution-lab checkout for the t3b action-space v1 experiment, what are the actions of the v1 action space, in their defined order? Answer as a comma-separated list.
On my AODL grants branch, what file name does a session-level AODL intent contract use, and what is the repo-level intent contract path? Answer as `<session file>|<repo-relative path>`.
My promotion-sim branch scored its holdout against the pre-registration. How many PRs were in the holdout set, and which hypotheses came out false? Answer as `<n>|<comma-separated hypothesis ids>`.
For my tool-calling portfolio experiment, what host:port does the bench-only llama.cpp router listen on, and what is its transient unit name? Answer as `<host:port>|<unit name>`.

On my orchestrator-router experiment branch, the A1 addendum re-scored the deterministic arm under the host local_order. What host local_order (provider names, in order) was used, and what was the deterministic arm's S1 pass rate rounded to two decimals? Answer as `<comma-separated providers>|<rate>`.

On my decision-opportunity branch, in the falsification eval results, what strict score did the repo-scoped (do_repo) arm get, and which pinned question ids did the question-scoped arm miss? Answer as `<score as k/n>|<comma-separated ids>`.
In my z0evals checkout for the local-offload-and-authority study, which claim ids in the study manifest end in `-fails`? Answer as a comma-separated list sorted alphabetically.
